name: Thrulls
description: Creatures created by the Order of the Ebon Hand who rebelled and came to hold dominion over all of Sarpadia.

description_citations.text: "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thrulls, bred for sacrifice, turn on the Order of the Ebon Hand with gruesome results.
timeline.quote: the Thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results

citation.text: Basal Thrull (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Thrulls breed at a terrifying pace and overwhelm the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

citation.text: Breeding Pit (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Endrek Sahr creates the first Thrulls by introducing alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy.
timeline.quote: To create the first Thrulls, I only introduced alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy

citation.text: Basal Thrull (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thrulls overwhelm the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: The thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

citation.text: Breeding Pit (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thrulls served faithfully until the Rebellion.
timeline.quote: "Until the Rebellion, thrulls served their masters faithfully—even at the cost of their own lives."

citation.text: Thrull Retainer (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thrulls bred for sacrifice turn on and overwhelm their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: the thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results.

citation.text: Basal Thrull (Masters Edition, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Reod and Eliza are locked up by the Thrulls, and Reod incites them to rebel.
timeline.quote: he and Eliza are locked up in a cell by the Thrulls

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Achtep Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eliza rescues Reod from torture, the thrulls kill the Ebon Hand, and Reod promises to aid their revolt.
timeline.quote: The thrulls kill the members of the Ebon Hand

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Achtep Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Order's thrulls overrun the whole of Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: the entire continent was overrun by the thrulls

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reod meets Eliza, is abducted to Achtep Keep, betrays Genkr Nik by starting a thrull rebellion, and is saved by Eliza.
timeline.quote: Reod betrays the deal by starting a rebellion among the Hand's thrulls

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dwarven kingdom falls to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins, followed by the Ebon Hand falling to the thrulls and the elves to the thallids.
timeline.quote: starting with the fall of the dwarven kingdom to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The thrulls destroy the goblins and the last of the orcs and keep evolving, content with their isolation.
timeline.quote: the goblins were destroyed by the thrulls

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Thrull Rebellion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Phyrexians are rumored to be defeated by thrulls on Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: it was rumored that the metal demons of Phyrexia met insurmountable resistance from the thrulls in Sarpadia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The Ebon Hand fell to their own creations
relations.quote: the fall of the Ebon Hand at the hands of their creations, the thrulls
